description: Trigger: peering/backpressure.rs records EMA as two separate atomic operations: load(Relaxed) then store(Relaxed). Two concurrent callers can both load the same old value, compute updated EMAs independently, and each store their own result. Bad behavior: one update is lost (classic lost-update race). The EMA metric can drift from the true value under concurrent load. The metric drives admittance decisions and backpressure logging, so a stale EMA can cause under-throttling.
title: EMA backpressure monitor has non-atomic read-modify-write race
